Story.title: Story
Story.description: A 24-hour temporary story uploaded from camera or gallery

userId.description: ID of the user who published the story

userAvatar.description: Profile picture URL of the author

mediaUrl.description: Image or video media data URL

caption.description: Caption overlay text on the story

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 string of story creation time

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 string of story expiry time (24 hours after creation)

expiresAtTimestamp.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when the story expires

filter.description: Visual color filter applied to the story

/stories/{storyId}.description: Real-time temporary stories that expire after 24 hours
